title: Research room
chatWelcome: Talk it through with your team
chatWelcomeHint: Choose a stock. Your team will research it, share their views, and organize reports alongside the chat. Join in whenever you like.
noModelShort: No AI model is connected. Only basic conclusions are available.
startingHint: The team is gathering sources for the first round. You can share a question while they work.
roomHint: Researcher · Challenger · Portfolio manager. Join the discussion any time.
keyboardHint: Enter to send · Shift + Enter for a new line
pausedHint: Paused. Messages are saved; use Continue above to resume research.
failedHint: You can add a message. Resolve the issue, then continue research above.
messageSavedRunFailed: Your message was saved, but research could not start. Use Continue above to retry.
intro: Bring a question to your team. Follow the evidence, challenge assumptions, and keep a versioned record of the decision.
analysisEntry: Discuss the evidence with your team
analysisHint: Add your own view, read the team's arguments, and revisit their conclusion.
newTitle: What should the team look into?
newHint: Choose your team. They will gather sources and exchange views. Join in whenever you like.
newInvalid: Enter a valid ticker (up to 20 characters) and check the selected investment profile.
noProfiles: Create a Builder profile first to give this discussion a team and its own rules.
profileChanged: This profile has changed. Start a new discussion with the current version before relying on its conclusion.
actionFailed: The action could not be completed.
noModel: No language model is available. Research returns a basic wait conclusion without AI member discussion. Connect a model to activate a council profile, or choose rules-only mode for deterministic price rules.
discussionHint: This room is for research. Only a later scan of the active Builder profile can submit a matching candidate to the paper-trading risk checks.
noMessages: The room is ready. Start research or leave the team a question.
noMessagesBasic: A basic conclusion is in the reports panel. Connect an AI model so the team can join the discussion.
runningHint: The team is researching. Replies will appear when ready…
composerPlaceholder: Share a thought or ask the team a question…
composerHint: Join in any time. The team will consider your messages.
messageAdded: Note added. Continue research to update the conclusion.
messageLimit: This discussion has reached 30 notes. Start a new discussion to continue adding context.

team.title: Meet your investment council
team.intro: Choose 2–6 members with different perspectives, personalities, and models. One moderator connects the discussion.
team.enabledHint: Council enabled: each candidate needs a current council review before the normal paper-trading checks.
team.rulesOnly: Rules-only mode: basic research and deterministic price rules. No model-based council approval is implied.
team.name: Member name

jobs.researcher: Build the investment case and cite the evidence.
jobs.challenger: Look for missing evidence, downside and reasons to wait.
jobs.manager: Weigh both views against the portfolio's limits.

prompts.manager: Prefer patience when the evidence is incomplete.

teamInvalid: Choose 2–6 distinct members and exactly one moderator. Check names, responsibilities, models, research focus, and prompt lengths.

members.editHint: Give this member a clear perspective and a way to join the conversation.
members.removeModeratorHint: Make another member the moderator before removing this one.
members.personalityPlaceholder: For example: patient, candid, and curious about the evidence.
members.moderatorHint: Each team has one moderator. Choosing this role makes the previous moderator a researcher.
members.promptHint: Up to 1,000 characters. Describe research methods, priorities, and communication style. Longer context is excerpted to fit the budget; an oversized latest message must be shortened.
members.connectionMissing: Model connection unavailable. Choose another connection.
members.modelsLoadFailed: Some model information could not be loaded.
members.webResearchHint: Structured financial data is fetched automatically (SEC is free). Web research uses DeepSeek Search and may be billed separately, with at most 2 searches per discussion. Off by default.
members.webDisabled: Enable web research for this team before choosing this focus.
members.webEnabledSnapshot: Web research is enabled for this discussion, within the research budget and search limits.
members.webDisabledSnapshot: Web research is off for this discussion. Structured financial data is still fetched automatically.
members.profileHint: You can chat without a profile. Selecting one loads its team, which you can customize before starting.
members.profilesLoadFailed: Investment profiles could not be loaded. Independent research is still available.
members.snapshotHint: This is the saved team for this discussion. Team changes start a new discussion and keep the existing history.
members.legacySnapshot: This older discussion has no member snapshot. Start a new discussion to choose and save a team.
members.useTeam: Start a new discussion with this team

chat.sourcePending: Source {{index}} was cited. Its details will appear when this round's report is saved.

progress.waiting: Research is underway. Completed source checks will appear here.

cadenceInvalid: Check review frequency (1–60), weekly orders (1–20), cooldown (0–60) and weekly turnover (0.1–100%).

cadence.title: Give good decisions time
cadence.intro: Review deliberately, trade sparingly. These limits also apply when you run a scan manually.
cadence.calendarHint: Trading days currently mean weekdays; exchange holidays are not excluded. Weekly limits use a rolling 7-day window. Manual scans respect the same limits.
cadence.summary: Review every {{days}} weekdays · up to {{orders}} orders / 7 days

report.manualHint: This report records views, supporting evidence, and disagreements. It does not generate orders.
report.title: Decision brief · v{{version}}
report.emptyHint: Reports appear here when the team finishes a research round.
report.detailHint: Read the full conclusion, reservations, review conditions, and evidence sources.
report.obsoleteHint: New input, a newer report, or a profile change has superseded this version. It is retained for context and cannot be treated as current approval.
report.noEvidence: No evidence was saved for this version.
report.frozenEvidence: Each report keeps its evidence snapshot. Continuing the discussion fetches fresh data.
report.tokens: Task usage through this version: {{count}} tokens (includes conservative charges).
report.olderOrder: Linked order {{id}} is outside this recent-order window. This feed does not show its current details; refer to the saved research link for its identifier.
report.executionHint: An approval is a research conclusion. A later active-profile scan must still pass freshness, cadence, budget and paper-trading risk checks. Real trades remain manual.

budget.title: Research budget
budget.intro: One shared allowance for model-assisted research. Hard limits keep each discussion and the whole day bounded.
budget.estimateHint: User-supplied rates; not a provider bill.
budget.accountingHint: Token counts use provider-reported usage when available. Missing usage and failed calls conservatively retain the reserved amount; estimates are not provider billing.
budget.utc: Day and month reset at UTC boundaries. Reserved work counts toward available capacity.
budget.limitHint: Input + output must fit one task; task ≤ day ≤ month. Task calls ≤ daily calls. Reaching a cap pauses model work rather than increasing the allowance.
budget.invalid: Limits must be positive whole numbers within the supported range.
budget.priceInvalid: Prices must be blank or between 0 and 100,000 USD per million tokens.
budget.inconsistent: Input + output ≤ task ≤ day ≤ month, and task calls ≤ daily calls.
